title: Bounded local GUI HTTP lifecycle diagnosis
status: FREEZE_BEFORE_EXECUTION; unread-body cause is a hypothesis
scope: HTTP server lifecycle, directly related HTTP tests and new diagnostic evidence only
observed_prior_failure: Each original GUI/browser run recorded nine passes and one cross-Origin /reset client Win10053 failure before HTTP status parsing. Preserve both records.
hypotheses: The valid framed POST body can arrive after headers are parsed; an early403 with unread bytes followed by HTTP/1.0 socket shutdown can reset the client before it receives the error status.
An unclosed urllib HTTPError response or server/thread teardown may instead contribute; inspect actual ownership and timing before attributing cause.
External scheduling or transport conditions may remain unresolved; do not label an unproven environment cause or treat a passing retry as proof.

execution_controls.every_test_compute_and_commit: Use the shared atomic lease, one core, IDLE priority, single library threads, --coordinate-cs and a finite wall limit.
execution_controls.town_priority: Normal-priority other priority work publishing retains priority; do not touch its or other tasks' processes.
execution_controls.lease_busy_exit75: Stop attempting jobs and await the parent's notification. Never busy-loop or remove another job's lease.
execution_controls.dependencies: Use the existing fpv-calibration venv and HTTP worktree PYTHONPATH; no installation or settings changes.
execution_controls.transport_failure: Not a test result. Inspect the unique receipt and Git state before any retry; never repeat a confirmed successful commit.

prechange_runs.name: gui-r5-pre-01
prechange_runs.purpose: One unchanged integration plus mocked-browser suite run; preserve the actual outcome and complete traceback.

prechange_runs.name: gui-r5-pre-02
prechange_runs.purpose: One deterministic split-send request with the original handler and finite event barriers. Instrument only body-read count, queued body bytes, response and shutdown order. Delay body until header parsing completes, and delay client response parsing until server shutdown completes to expose unread-data closure.
prechange_runs.request: POST /reset, Content-Length2, application/json, body{}, Origin https://example.com
prechange_runs.limits: Exactly one controlled rejected POST. Socket timeouts and barriers are finite; no probabilistic repeat loop.
prechange_runs.causality: Record a real client status/error and whether the original handler leaves body bytes unread. Instrumented timing is disclosed; it is distinct from ordinary-suite reproduction.

repair_conditions.required: A demonstrated lifecycle defect with evidence supporting the change; keep unresolved attribution explicit.
repair_conditions.candidate_if_supported: Consume only a valid declared body within the existing4096-byte limit before completing a rejected request; bound the read. Keep the Origin allowlist, local bind, status/security decisions, JSON validation and transactional state behavior.
repair_conditions.invalid_framing: Never drain unbounded data, guess a body length or accept oversized/ambiguous requests. Preserve rejection and disclose any intentionally closed malformed transport.
repair_conditions.no_test_masking: Do not suppress Win10053, catch arbitrary client failures as expectedHTTPError, relax assertions, add sleeps until lucky, or change network/security settings.

postchange_runs.name: gui-r5-post-01
postchange_runs.purpose: The deterministic lifecycle regression and focused HTTP security/framing/transaction checks. New observations must explain any additional correction.

postchange_runs.name: gui-r5-post-02
postchange_runs.purpose: The unchanged integration and mocked-browser suite plus the focused new HTTP tests; broader scope, not a lucky retry. Use only if justified and remain within the two-run cap.

acceptance: Prior failure logs, all new argv/stdout/stderr/receipts and the exact diagnostic source are retained.
A supported lifecycle mechanism is distinguished from any unproven explanation of historical Win10053.
Readable403 for the valid controlled rejected request and unchanged cross-Origin rejection/state assertions; no error-as-success substitution.
Original scientific sources, data, parameters, protocols, numerical results, gates and failures remain byte-identical to the baseline.
A local commit and reviewable diff are delivered; no push, merge, deployment or source acquisition.
stop_conditions: Lease busy or observed Lean/Lake requires defer/pause own work only.
Once the two prechange attempts are used, stop reproduction; do not expand a hidden loop.
If cause is not established, state it and do not claim historical Win10053 resolved.
After applicable checks pass, only seal evidence and commit; no additional scientific computation or GUI retry.
Any remaining failure after two postchange runs is retained and reported.
